name: Aluminium Extrusion Industries Plc
source: Aluminium Extrusion Industries Plc audited financial statements for the year ended 31 December 2024, filed with the Nigerian Exchange (NGX corporate disclosure, quarter 5 filing, March 2025). The filing is a scanned copy with no text layer and was read by OCR; both printed identities were checked against the document before the rows were written. The company has no 2025 accounts filed and has not been quoted on the official daily price list since 21 July 2026
unit: NGN, printed in N thousands and converted to naira; earnings per share printed in kobo and converted to naira (90 kobo equals 0.90 naira)

rows.label: Cost of Sales
rows.sign_normalized: negated to the dataset convention: stored negative, which broke the printed identity Revenue - Cost of Sales = Gross Profit, and the column ties with it positive

derivation.note: Revenue is printed on the source statement; the scanned OCR of that line was unreadable, so the two revenue figures are the ones that satisfy the printed identity Revenue less Cost of Sales equals Gross Profit on the same statement, and they agree with the independent market data record for the same years (2,781 million naira for FY2024 and 2,088 million for FY2023)

alias_basis: same issuer: listing carries ALEXA (sym ALEXA.CA, no session) and ALEX (sym ALEX.CA, price 21.99, volume 3148 on 2026-09-24), both named Alexandria Cement
